prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a beautifully clear Chinese visual design handoff board for a virtual workout companion. The provided image is a STYLE REFERENCE only: use the panda's cute black and cream colors, rounded body, simple happy face, muted sage wristband, and retro pixel feeling. Show only the PANDA, not the seal. This is an illustrative CONCEPT BOARD, not a screenshot of actual software and not a professional exercise teaching diagram. Landscape layout, three equal large panels side by side on a warm ivory background, clean thin separators and highly readable dark Chinese sans-serif labels.
Title at top: "同一个角色，三维驱动，像素呈现"
Panel 1 title: "① 三维关节结构". Show a cute rounded simplified 3D panda in neutral standing pose, around 2.7 heads tall, arms long enough for visible shoulders and elbows. Overlay a FEW simple cyan connected lines and joint dots on shoulders, elbows, wrists and torso, like a conceptual rig drawing. Do not draw anatomical human bones or dense mesh.
Panel 2 title: "② 哑光卡通基底". Show exactly the SAME panda with matching proportions, color areas and face, in a friendly one-arm-raised pose, smooth matte toon material, 2-3 broad shading values, no realistic fur, no shiny reflections, not blocky voxel geometry.
Panel 3 title: "③ 像素化显示". Show exactly the SAME pose, character, size and viewpoint as panel 2 but rendered with clearly visible regular pixel-art stepping and limited palette. The underlying rounded 3D volume should still be understandable. This is controlled stylization, not blurry mosaic. Do not make the body out of Minecraft cubes. Preserve readable upper arm, elbow and paw shape.
Small simple arrows connect panel 1 to panel 2 and panel 2 to panel 3. Under the panels add one centered line: "预设动作与实时镜像，共用同一角色"
At bottom in smaller but readable text: "设计参考图 · 不是运行截图或已完成模型"
Keep feet and raised paw fully inside each panel, comfortable margins, no extra props, no gym equipment, no unrelated logos, no English slogans, no watermark. Professional visual communication, accurate typography, original character, crisp final render.

referenceRound2Prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A single cohesive visual exploration sheet of TWO ORIGINAL kawaii animal companions for an adult-friendly workout app: a GIANT PANDA and a SEAL, sharing one art direction. The user wants MUCH MORE CARTOONY AND CUTE, less realistic and less human than previous explorations. Neither should resemble a muscular adult with an animal head. Squat, round, iconic silhouettes, around 2 to 2.5 heads tall, very simple appealing facial features, friendly gentle energy. The panda has black round ears and black eye patches. The seal has no external ears, a wide tiny muzzle with just two little whisker marks on each cheek, flipper-like hands, pale blue-gray skin and a cream belly. Both can stand upright with two short legs and two rounded arms; arms still have enough length to lift visibly. Full body visible. Very small muted wristband only; no costumes or bodybuilding clothes, no props. Plain warm off-white background. Clean presentation with two large characters SIDE BY SIDE at comparable scale: panda on left, seal on right. Each waves a single arm naturally, each has two arms and two legs only. Put the candidate letter as the ONLY typography in the top-left, clean and readable. Do NOT use existing IP characters, famous character likenesses, logos, or words. This is an independent new design, not an edit of previous generated images. Letter "J". STRICTLY CRISP AUTHENTIC PIXEL ART, like a carefully designed 48-to-64-pixel tall game sprite shown at large nearest-neighbor scale. Every contour stair-stepped on a consistent square pixel grid. Limited harmonious palette of ivory, charcoal, powder blue, blush peach and muted sage. Thick 1-pixel dark contour in native sprite resolution, 2 or 3 tone shading per color, chunky chibi silhouettes, tiny 1-to-2-pixel eye shapes, simple happy mouth. Panda and seal stand and wave. No anti-aliasing, no blurry interpolation, no 3D, no smooth illustration edges, no voxel render. Warm retro handheld-game companion energy, cute rather than combat-ready. Both sprites sharp and easy to compare.
